closenessDefinitions.E: same movement, needs a new equipment drawing
closenessDefinitions.N: new movement (no approved plate has this joint action or body position)

poseStatus.S: solved by the engine in the libht probe (pose resolves; untuned)
poseStatus.M: follows from the same model, not probed

seat.evidence: approved: lat pulldown, machine chest press, seated row

recline.evidence: approved: leg press (pelvis tilt -60), machine chest press

lean.evidence: approved: back squat trunk 40 deg forward

overhead.evidence: approved: arms overhead in pull-up and lat pulldown; standing overhead solved (probe E)

hinge.evidence: probe F: tilt 70, hip 90, one plant, foot error 0.1 cm

incline.evidence: probe B: tilt -45, hands on a bar, 0 cm; torso angles -28 to -60 exist in approved plates (leg press, lat pulldown mistake)

supine.evidence: probe A/K: tilt -90, hands 0 cm, feet 0.5 cm; rendered through renderPlate with bench + barbell; untuned

decline.evidence: probe M: tilt -105, angles only (no contact solve, not rendered)

prone.evidence: probe C: tilt +90, angles only (no contact solve, not rendered)

plank.evidence: probe D: tilt +80, hands 0 cm, toes 0.6 to 2.4 cm (untuned); rendered

quad.evidence: probe H: tilt 88, hip 90, knee 90, hands 0 cm

single.evidence: probe F: one plant, the other leg free; rendered

split.evidence: probe J: two plants at different z, rear on the ball, 0.2 and 2.4 cm (untuned)

kneel.evidence: probe G: knee 90 by angles; no knee-on-floor contact solve, use checks{plane}

bridge.evidence: probe K: tilt -12, feet planted, 0.5 cm

floorsit.evidence: probe L: seated on floor, torso leaned back

support.evidence: hands on bars or a bench with the body clear of the floor: reach IK + angles, not probed

wall.evidence: root and angles plus a line: not probed

airborne.evidence: root.at is free in the pose schema; a jump apex is just a pose

roll.evidence: normPose has only root {at, tilt}: no roll about the z axis

yaw.evidence: no whole-body or trunk yaw in normPose (SPEC 8)

dumbbell.label: dumbbell
dumbbell.engineFact: dumbbell(): hex end-on or bar+heads side-on, axis parameter

barbell.label: barbell
barbell.engineFact: barbell(): front = shaft, sleeves, collars, 450 mm plates; side = near plate outline + sleeve dot

rack.label: squat/bench rack upright
rack.engineFact: rackUpright(): 76 mm tube, J-hook height; no safety arms

flatBench.label: flat bench
flatBench.engineFact: bench(): 1.2 m pad, T-legs; flat only (no angle parameter)

pullupBar.label: pull-up bar
pullupBar.engineFact: pullupBar(): 32 mm bar, wall or ceiling mount, any height

cable.label: cable column + stack
cable.engineFact: cableColumn(): pulley at any world point, stack, wrap +-1

pivotArm.label: pivot-arm handle (chest-press lever)
pivotArm.engineFact: chestPress(): lever + neutral grip + pivot, side view

backPad.label: back pad at any angle
backPad.engineFact: backPad(): angle or surface, any tilt

kneePad.label: roller pad
kneePad.engineFact: kneePad(): 11 cm roller at a contact point

straightBar.label: straight bar
straightBar.engineFact: latBar with drop 0 and straight = width (checked: draws one bar in side and 3 collinear segments in front view)

singleHandle.label: single cable handle
singleHandle.engineFact: short latBar or box; side view is a circle

legPressFlat.label: horizontal leg press
legPressFlat.engineFact: legPress45 with rail.angle 0 (checked: draws, plate normal (0,0,-1))

ezBar.label: EZ bar
ezBar.engineFact: side view = the barbell end-on drawing; the zig-zag needs a front view and does not exist (SPEC 8)

inclineBench.label: adjustable bench (incline or upright)
inclineBench.engineFact: seat() + backPad(angle); bench() has no angle parameter

legExtMachine.label: leg extension machine
legExtMachine.engineFact: seat + backPad + kneePad(shin roller) + line lever + stack

legCurlMachine.label: leg curl machine (seated, lying, standing)
legCurlMachine.engineFact: pads + kneePad(ankle roller) + line lever + stack

calfMachine.label: calf raise machine (seated / standing)
calfMachine.engineFact: kneePad lever or shoulder pads + box platform

pecDeck.label: pec deck (fly / reverse fly)
pecDeck.engineFact: seat + backPad + two pivot arms; front view of the arm primitive is not verified

latRaiseMachine.label: lateral raise machine
latRaiseMachine.engineFact: seat + pivotArm + pads; front view not verified

assistMachine.label: assisted pull-up machine
assistMachine.engineFact: kneePad on a platform (box) + handles + stack

band.label: resistance band
band.engineFact: line + anchor box; a band has no engine item

smith.label: Smith machine
smith.engineFact: rails + carriage bar + hooks + stoppers: rackUpright + barbell cannot draw the carriage; not in equipment.mjs

rope.label: cable rope attachment
rope.engineFact: ropes are listed as not supported (SPEC 8)

ropeLikely.label: cable rope attachment (standard for this lift; the data only says Cable)

landmine.label: landmine / T-bar (angled bar on a floor pivot)
landmine.engineFact: bars with angled sleeves are not covered (SPEC 8); barbell() is horizontal only

hackSled.label: hack squat sled
hackSled.engineFact: not in equipment.mjs (legPress45 moves a footplate, not a body-carrying sled)

romanChair.label: Roman chair / 45 deg back extension bench

meta.contactDerivation: GA 3.2 gives the definitions and totals only; the per-id split is derived here and reproduces the GA totals exactly (asserted).
